mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the reflex pathways to the body was most worthwhile: the planned comparison of head and eye movements ties the anatomy to a practical function.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the nerve pathways was straightforward but offered little explanation of how their signals reach or influence the brainstem.

surprise.text: The weighted-membrane comparison clarified that these organs respond both to gravity and to changes in straight-line motion, rather than steady motion itself.

arbitrary.text: Assembling both balance organs before adding their nerve pathways felt like a game-imposed ordering; the feedback made the required pairing clear, but not why separate connection was impossible.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: linking sensory structures to observable eye and postural responses made the construction interesting, though some intermediate connections were brief.
